exposure: Written after the strict rules by the same author. Self-authored bias; held-out results are regression evidence only.
format: Each unit is [text, reasonCodes comma-separated (empty = negative for every category), hard-negative categories comma-separated]. Every document is complete for all six categories.

documents.title: Brightline Fitness membership
units: Your Brightline membership renews automatically every month until you cancel.
If you do not cancel before your billing date, we will charge the card on file for the next month.
Day passes are a one-time purchase and never renew.
You can cancel your membership online at any time from the Account page.
Class prices shown on the schedule include all taxes.
We will email you a receipt after every payment.

documents.title: Quillnote Pro subscription
units: Quillnote Pro is billed annually and renews at the then-current list price.
We may increase the subscription fee for future renewal periods after giving you 30 days notice.
Your price is locked for as long as your subscription stays active.
Monthly plans do not renew automatically; you choose whether to buy another month.
Students can renew their verification each school year to keep the discount.
Refunds for duplicate charges are issued within ten business days.

documents.title: Harborview Parking permits
units: Annual permits can only be cancelled by sending written notice by certified mail to our office.
Permits continue to bill each quarter until we receive your cancellation.
A replacement permit costs ten dollars.
Your permit expires on the date printed on the card and is not extended automatically.
You can renew an expired permit at the front desk if you want one again.
Parking rates may change for daily visitors without notice.

documents.title: Lumen Stream television
units: After your free trial ends, your plan converts to a paid subscription that recurs monthly.
To cancel, you must call our retention team during business hours.
The free trial ends without any charge if you choose not to start a paid plan.
Rentals are single purchases and are available for 48 hours.
Cancelling stops future charges and you keep access until the end of the paid period.
We may change the catalogue of shows at any time.

documents.title: Copperleaf Meal Kits
units: Your weekly box subscription automatically renews each week and your card is charged every Thursday.
An early termination fee of 25 dollars applies if you cancel within the first three months of your plan.
You can skip any week before Wednesday at noon without being charged.
One-off gift boxes are paid once and do not recur.
We may substitute ingredients when a supplier runs out.
Delivery fees are shown at checkout before you pay.

documents.title: Northgate Cloud Storage
units: Storage plans renew automatically for successive one-year terms.
Renewal terms are charged at our standard rate in effect at the time of renewal, which may be higher than your introductory price.
You must give at least 60 days notice before the end of the term to cancel your plan.
We remind you by email two weeks before any renewal and you can turn renewal off in settings.
Free accounts stay free and are never billed.
Our servers are powered by renewable energy.
You may download your files at any time before you close your account.

documents.title: Pinecrest Magazine
units: Print subscriptions continue to be billed every issue until you tell us to stop.
Cancellation requests are accepted only by telephone and no refunds are given for issues already shipped.
Single issues can be bought at newsstands for the cover price.
Gift subscriptions end after the gifted term and the recipient is never charged.
We may change the cover price of single issues sold in shops.
Back issues are available while supplies last.

documents.title: Orbit VPN
units: Orbit VPN plans auto-renew at the end of each billing cycle.
After the first year, your plan renews at the regular price instead of the promotional price.
You can request a full refund within 30 days of your first purchase.
Renewal reminders are sent seven days in advance, and turning off auto-renewal takes one click.
Lifetime licences are paid once and never billed again.
We do not charge a cancellation fee.
Prices are listed in US dollars.

documents.title: Fernway Software maintenance
units: Maintenance and support renew automatically for one-year terms unless either party gives notice of non-renewal.
We may adjust maintenance fees at renewal by up to the change in the consumer price index.
Perpetual software licences purchased outright do not require renewal.
Maintenance ends on the expiry date unless you choose to buy another term.
Training courses are billed per seat and do not recur.

documents.title: Kestrel Kids learning app
units: The family plan is a recurring subscription charged to your app store account each month.
To cancel a subscription bought on our website, you must email support and wait for written confirmation.
Cancelling in the app store settings takes effect at the end of the current month.
Classroom licences are purchased by schools for one school year and expire in June.
Parents can renew a lost password from the sign-in screen.
New lessons are added every week at no extra cost.

documents.title: Brightline Fitness privacy notice
units: We sell your personal information, including workout history, to fitness marketing companies.
We share your contact details with partner gyms so they can send you their own offers.
We use cookies to keep you signed in.
We keep your workout data for two years after your last visit.
Do not share your membership barcode with other people.
You can share your workout streak with friends from the app if you choose.

documents.title: Quillnote privacy policy
units: We do not sell your personal information, but we may share it with our affiliates and business partners.
Advertising networks may receive your device identifiers and browsing activity from our apps.
We will never sell your notes or the personal information in your account.
Service providers that host our servers process your data only on our instructions and under contract.
We may disclose information when a court order requires it.
Aggregated statistics that cannot identify you may be published in our annual report.

documents.title: Harborview resident app privacy
units: Your personal data may be sold to third parties as part of our data licensing program.
We may provide your personal information to data brokers who combine it with other sources.
We encrypt your personal information in transit and at rest.
We do not share your personal information with advertisers.
Building staff can see your unit number to deliver packages.
You may ask us to delete your personal data at any time.

documents.title: Lumen Stream privacy
units: We share your viewing history with advertising partners to show you targeted ads on other sites.
Information about you may be disclosed to our co-marketing sponsors.
Profiles for children are never used for advertising and are not shared.
We use first-party cookies to measure which shows are popular.
You can share a show link with a friend by text message.
We retain payment records for seven years to meet tax rules.

documents.title: Copperleaf privacy
units: We may sell or rent your name, address and order history to other food brands.
We may share your personal information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.
Delivery partners receive only your address and delivery notes so they can drop off your box.
We never sell your personal information to anyone.
Your recipe ratings are stored in your account.
If you share your referral code, friends who use it get a discount.

documents.title: Northgate Cloud privacy
units: We share usage data with analytics vendors who may use it to improve their own products.
Customer data is shared with our marketing partners for joint promotional campaigns.
We do not read or sell the contents of your files.
Our subprocessors act only on our behalf and may not use your data for their own purposes.
We may disclose personal information if the law requires it.
Shared folders are visible only to the people you invite.

documents.title: Pinecrest Magazine privacy
units: We rent our subscriber list, including your name and mailing address, to other publishers.
Your personal information is shared with advertisers who sponsor our newsletters.
You can opt out of postal mail from us at any time.
We do not disclose your reading history to other companies.
We store your payment details with a payment processor that handles them on our behalf.
Readers can share articles on social media using the share button.

documents.title: Orbit VPN privacy
units: We may sell de-identified browsing data together with your account email to research firms.
We transfer your personal information to our parent company and its affiliates for their marketing.
We do not log the websites you visit.
Connection timestamps are deleted after 24 hours.
We will not share your personal information with third parties except as needed to process payments.
Never share your VPN password with anyone.

documents.title: Fernway Software privacy
units: Contact information of your users may be disclosed to our reseller partners.
We share personal data with third-party advertising networks to measure campaign results.
We do not sell personal information as defined by applicable law.
Crash reports are anonymized before we store them.
Administrators can export user lists from the dashboard.
We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to work.

documents.title: Kestrel Kids privacy
units: We may share information about you and your child with educational partners who offer related products.
Parent email addresses may be sold to companies that sell school supplies.
We never show behavioral advertising to children.
Teachers can see the progress of students in their class.
We delete a child's data when the parent closes the account.
Parents can share progress reports with grandparents by email.

documents.title: Snapgrove photo sharing terms
units: You grant us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide license to use, copy and modify any photos you upload.
The license you grant includes the right to sublicense your content to our partners.
You keep ownership of the photos you upload.
We grant you a limited licence to use the Snapgrove app on your devices.
You can license your photos to others through our marketplace and set your own price.
Deleting a photo removes it from your public profile within 24 hours.

documents.title: Wordloft writing community terms
units: By posting a story you give Wordloft an irrevocable license to publish, adapt and translate it.
We may use the stories you post under this license to train and improve our AI writing assistant.
Our AI writing assistant is trained only on public-domain books and licensed text, not on your stories.
The license you grant ends when you delete your story, except for copies already shared by other readers.
Wordloft is released under an open-source license on our code site.
You are responsible for having the rights to anything you post.

documents.title: Tunewell music upload terms
units: You grant Tunewell a royalty-free, sublicensable license to distribute the recordings you upload.
Your recordings may be used to train machine learning models under the license you grant us.
The licence we receive is non-exclusive, revocable and ends when you remove the track.
We do not use your recordings to train AI models.
Artists keep all copyright in their recordings.
You may license your music to film makers through any agency you choose.

documents.title: Mapleboard forum terms
units: You grant us a perpetual license to display and reuse any post you make, even after you delete your account.
We may transfer or sublicense the rights in your posts to any successor of our business.
Posts are licensed to other users under a Creative Commons licence that you choose.
We need a license to host your posts so that other members can read them while they are online.
Moderators may remove posts that break the community rules.
You can edit your own posts at any time.

documents.title: Clipnest video terms
units: The license you grant us in your videos is worldwide, irrevocable and survives termination of these terms.
You grant us the right to use the videos you upload to develop and train our artificial intelligence models.
We train our recommendation models on viewing counts, not on the content of your videos.
You may revoke our license to any video by deleting it.
We license music from labels for use in our editing tools.
Videos marked private are visible only to you.

documents.title: Recipely recipe site terms
units: You grant us a perpetual, royalty-free license to publish your recipes and photos in our cookbooks.
We may sublicense the recipes you submit to our publishing partners.
You do not grant us any right to publish your recipes outside the website.
Our site license lets you print recipes for personal use.
Recipes you submit stay credited to your username.
We may feature popular recipes on the home page for as long as they remain posted.

documents.title: Penstroke design marketplace terms
units: You grant Penstroke an irrevocable license to use your designs in our marketing, with the right to sublicense those rights to agencies.
Designs you upload may be used under this license as training data for our generative image models.
Buyers receive a license to your design only after paying for it.
Our generative models are trained on stock images we purchased, never on uploaded designs.
You may withdraw a design from sale at any time.
You keep all intellectual property rights in your designs.

documents.title: Hearthside reviews terms
units: By submitting a review you grant us a perpetual and irrevocable license to use it in any media.
Reviews may be sublicensed to the businesses you review for use in their advertising.
Businesses may reply to your review publicly.
We only use your review on our own site and remove it when you ask.
The license we take to your review ends when you delete it.
We use automated tools to detect fake reviews.

documents.title: Chatterbox messaging terms
units: You license us to use the messages and voice recordings you send to train our speech recognition models.
The rights you grant in your messages are perpetual and may be sublicensed to our affiliates.
Messages are end-to-end encrypted and we cannot read them.
We do not use your messages to train AI models.
You may forward a message to another chat.
Stickers are licensed to you for use inside Chatterbox only.

documents.title: Gallerie art portfolio terms
units: You grant us a worldwide, sublicensable license to reproduce the artwork in your portfolio.
Uploaded artwork may be used under the license you grant to fine-tune our AI style models.
We take only the license needed to show your portfolio to visitors.
Our AI tools never learn from portfolio images.
You can choose a licence for each artwork that visitors must follow.
Removing your portfolio ends our right to display it.

units: Any dispute arising from these terms will be resolved by final and binding arbitration.
You agree to bring claims only in your individual capacity and not as part of any class action.
You waive any right to a jury trial for claims related to the service.
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Oregon.

Your continued use of the service after we post updated terms means you accept the changes.
We will not change these terms without your consent.
